normative_contract.status: email composition and asynchronous SMTP send API
routes_or_registry_hooks: Schedules `aiosmtplib.send` on the running event loop
Retries `SMTPConnectError` up to five attempts with exponential wait
signatures: mail_notify(subject: str | None = None, body: str | None = None, msg: EmailMessage | None = None, html: bool = False, receivers: list[str] | None = None) -> Awaitable

send_mail(sender: str, receivers: list[str], password: str, msg: EmailMessage | None = None, host: str | None = None, port: int = 25, cc: list[str] | None = None, bcc: list[str] | None = None, subject: str | None = None, body: str | None = None, username: str | None = None) -> Awaitable
compose(subject: str, plain_txt: str | None = None, html: str | None = None, attachment: str | None = None) -> EmailMessage
accepted_inputs_and_boundaries: `msg` is mutually exclusive with subject/body and one form is required.
Mail notify resolves configured sender/server/receivers and `QUANTIDE_MAIL_PASSWORD`; blank receiver input uses configured recipients.
Compose requires html or truthy plain text; optional attachment is read from filesystem.
observable_outputs: Compose returns EmailMessage with Subject, plain or HTML body, and optional MIME attachment.
Send sets From/To/subject/Cc/Bcc/body, defaults username variable and host, schedules SMTP send, and returns the task.
Mail notify composes a product-branded default subject when omitted and returns `send_mail` result.
failure_error_fallback: Mutually exclusive/missing message inputs raise `TypeError`; missing compose body raises `AssertionError`.
Attachment I/O/MIME errors and event-loop errors propagate.
SMTPConnectError is retried per decorator then propagates; other SMTP failures propagate.
state_mutations_and_cleanup: Mutates the supplied/new EmailMessage headers/body; reads environment/config/file; creates an asyncio task. It does not await or cancel the task.
normative_contract.evidence_note: SMTP/tenacity/config imports are dependencies, not exports; the username discrepancy is not rewritten as a requirement.
